description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractThingEventStrategy' that implements event handling logic for 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides mechanisms to handle null checks, merge metadata, and apply events to 'Thing' builders, serving as a base for specific event strategies.

classes.name: AbstractThingEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing event handling logic for 'Thing' objects, providing methods to handle null checks, merge metadata, and apply events, serving as a base for specific event strategies.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a 'ThingEvent' and optionally a 'Thing', updating the 'Thing' with new revision, timestamp, and metadata if 'Thing' is not null.

methods.name: mergeMetadata
methods.description: Merges metadata from the event and the 'Thing', considering resource path and presence of metadata, returning the combined 'Metadata'.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: A protected method intended to be overridden by subclasses to apply specific event logic to the 'ThingBuilder'.
